observation.series: The Information System of a Planet

episodes.title: When Life Learned Before It Died

slides.title: The archive begins inside life
The molecular system was already online
Physics sets the performance ceiling
A much faster clock appears
Experience becomes writable
There was never one ladder of minds
The first copy leaves the original body
A memory finds another body
A flock stores a local setting
The map can live in the flock
A distributed file can cross an ocean
Culture was never ours alone
Distributed storage has failure modes
The network has a bandwidth limit

episodes.title: How Much Can a Message Carry?

slides.title: The network has many incompatible ports
Physics edits every message
A message can carry a category
A message can point somewhere else
A message can address one individual
A small repertoire can be recombined
Then the clock becomes foggy again

episodes.title: When a Message Could Become Almost Anything

slides.title: Millions of years, no first sentence
The interface was never only sound
A small kit becomes a huge address space
The present is no longer the address limit
A learner can debug the hidden step
Many minds can edit the same future
The archive can last generations — but it still breathes
After the voices go quiet
Prehistory arrives through a brutal filter
A hand waits 67,800 years
A pattern learns to repeat
A picture can hold a scene
Then a record answers a small question exactly
